verdict.rationale: Notion is a workspace and knowledge-management SaaS. Its agents and APIs read, create and update workspace content; they do not implement software and then check it visually. Having an agent navigate an app and take before-and-after screenshots to verify its own implementation is a coding-agent or browser-automation capability, so this axis does not fit Notion's product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Notion shipping any screenshot or UI-navigation verification feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
